effective_result_rules: For a valid files=None request, work_buffer_bytes is still the known fixed73738; aggregate_R_range/aggregate_C_range are informational, and all exact vector-dependent fields/comparisons remain unresolved.
Aggregate range fields are None whenever a full vector is supplied. Null optional aggregate hints then cause no unknowns; exact vector sums/counts derive those values.
Known exceedance means an exact-vector computed term in limit_comparisons. Do not enforce caps from aggregate hint/range lower bounds. Aggregate-only cannot reach WITHIN_DECLARED_BOUNDS_ONLY.
Malformed result keeps the five fixed reference constants; other derived fields (including work_buffer_bytes) are None, unknowns=[], one deterministic invalid violation.
Status precedence remains invalid metadata/checked overflow, then exact known cap exceedance even if other terms unknown, then indeterminate, then conditional within-declared only.
no_change: Request/result keys,32derived fields,roles,limits andrepresentation coefficients unchanged
No aggregate-range admission,new coefficient, runtime cap/role/stream/output or production feature
All current runtime/actual verification and profile gates remain unchanged; old FAILED/INCOMPLETE_TIMEOUT preserved
overflow: Use exact integer comparisons, never float coercion, wrapping, clamping or default zero.
Input and returned derived integer domain is0..2^63-1. A mathematically unrepresentable required sum/product returns REFUSED_INVALID_METADATA with ARITHMETIC_OVERFLOW.

Ceil division must use quotient plus a remainder indicator (or equivalent safe arithmetic), not size+65535. Valid size/total at2^63-1 must not fail solely from an avoidable intermediate ceil addition.
A null coefficient leaves its dependent product unknown; do not evaluate that unknown product as0 or overflow. Known exact limits still exceed independently.
packet_and_units: Metadata IDs may be permuted; each sizing array file_id is the canonical list ordinal.

The closure sizing row uses file_id,invoked:false,return_observed:false,success:false; this is a longest-bool mathematical bound, not a valid observed-history claim. Digest rows use ordinal,size,sha256. Compact sorted ASCII JSON array lengths exclude LF.

The8192 value is an unchanged current-runtime reference. Caller max_packet_bytes is compared with the declared packet bound, not silently replaced by8192; a larger declared envelope grants no current runtime support.

All representation coefficients are strictly positive declared logical payload assumptions; zero refuses, unknown remains unknown. An absent structure can yield a zero multiplied term. No RSS/layout/timing qualification.

J retained rows plus J join workspace are counted separately in2J. Five distinct packet capacity slots are reserved once each, not a claim allfive occur in one history. Report output V is included in output reservation and within report_copies*V for memory, not added to memory again. Physical report transport remains unselected.
precode: At most30 explicit calculator-only metadata vectors, including all12 isolated limit boundaries, exact known-exceeds+unknown and checked-overflow cases; no implementation before root scope.
snapshot_and_checks: Invoke check at entry, then build the bounded closed-shape detached immutable snapshot before further callbacks. The initial callback may change caller data before that capture; semantic work then uses only the captured snapshot.
Invoke check at least once immediately after the detached snapshot; this is the second callback. Later callback mutation of caller lists/dicts must not alter captured inputs or result consistency.
Invoke checks during bounded per-file, graph and derivation work. Callback return values are ignored; BaseExceptions retain identity and are never translated as metadata errors.
Prepare the complete immutable report and its canonical encoded bytes, then invoke a final check immediately before returning it. No caller metadata is reread after capture.
Report to_dict/to_json_bytes getters are cached read-only operations: detached containers or retained immutable bytes, no callbacks, recalculation, I/O or authority.
validation_order: Closed schema/key checks, bounded exact structural/type/numeric capture in declared request/record field order, file identity/role/digest semantics, declared graph/binding, optional aggregate consistency, then checked arithmetic/comparisons. Exact-code vectors isolate one defect; multiple-invalid inputs receive the earliest deterministic validation error.
